behavior: added subtrees and relevant attribute/text changes are coalesced and reconciled incrementally
SPA navigation updates route markers and schedules a full reconciliation
WXT invalidation cleans watchers, observers, requests, frames and MAIN bridge listeners
the channel scanner is disconnected while the preference is disabled
